quest.title: Isaac's Vengeance
quest.description: The rumor around Sanguine is that the Five Beards Trading Company, is willing to pay a lot of $[Resource.G.r_gold_NameSingular] for the contents of a missing lockbox. More information can be found at one of their agents. It is known that most of the time they can be found in places underground.

node.journal_entry: Agents of the Five Beards Trading Company had indeed an offer.
